limitations: AppKit bitmap+numeric OCR endpoint, not compositor/photon timing
No authentication files or model requests; isolated default quota has no live credentials
Small pair counts are pilots, not >=100-condition acceptance
No E1 PASS inferred from capture or build
First-click timing is emitted only for the original routed click without a ready-click retry; process-entry timing remains separate
External CGEvent,not physical mouse. Receiver legacy operator/manual fields describe wait/action counts only;automated event journal owns input provenance.
report.click_precondition: AX unique target and hit-test;no App preactivation;one synthetic down/up per independent instance

toolchain.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.3 (swiftlang-6.3.0.123.5 clang-2100.0.123.102)
Target: x86_64-apple-macosx26.0

matrix.quota_pressure: controlled cancellable 30s dependency delay,not real network
matrix.rebuild_pressure: identified private maintenance processing >120s;action within worker interval;queue/setup/CLI wall separate
matrix.no_cache_precondition: current candidate-schema committed DB;cache removed without changing facts
matrix.upgrade_control: upgrade-no-cache is a separate optional diagnostic from the original imported schema
matrix.baseline_restore_compatibility: not assumed;all arms receive identical prepared DB/cache;schema-ahead failures remain failures

summary.reason: Collector summary only; model clocks are not frames. Pressure,oracle,P03,startup endpoints and independent gates require their own evidence.

interruption.action: exact private App terminated;failed attempt retained,no repeat click on same instance
interruption.causality_limit: Later lock observation explains current inability to continue;not proof of exact lock time relative to attempt149.

controller_method.target: exact previously verified executable path,unique AXExtrasMenuBar item,AX global hit PID matches target
controller_method.event: CGEvent mouse move,100ms wait,leftMouseDown,100ms wait,leftMouseUp,no modifiers,no App activation
controller_method.receiver_request_binding: unique instance UUID and request;never retry after posting
controller_method.clock_origin: native button action to first valid numeric bitmap/readback;not physical mouse-down or compositor
